title: Mandatory Attendance Policy (75% Rule & Condonation)
content:
SR University Academic Attendance Regulations:
- 75% Attendance Requirement: A student must acquire a minimum of 75% attendance in aggregate of all credit courses in each semester to be eligible to appear for the Semester End Examinations (SEE).
- Medical Condonation (65% to 74.99%): Attendance between 65% and 74.99% may be condoned by the Academic Council / Dean of Academics solely on valid medical grounds (such as hospitalization or contagious illness) supported by authentic medical certificates submitted within 3 days of return, along with prescribed condonation fees.
- Detention Below 65%: Students with less than 65% aggregate attendance are strictly DETAINED. They are NOT eligible to appear for semester-end examinations, cannot progress to the next year until the shortage is made up, and must re-register for the semester courses when offered next.
- Monitoring: Attendance is logged daily by faculty and is accessible in real-time to students and parents on the SRAAP portal (https://sraap.in/student_login.php).

title: Grading System, SGPA/CGPA Calculation, and Passing Criteria
content:
SR University Examination and Grading Regulations:
- 10-Point Letter Grading Scale: O (Outstanding, 10), A+ (Excellent, 9), A (Very Good, 8), B+ (Good, 7), B (Above Average, 6), C (Average, 5), P (Pass, 4), F (Fail, 0), Ab (Absent, 0).
- Course Weightage: Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE: mid examinations, practical assessments, quizzes, assignments - 40 marks) + Semester End Examination (SEE: 60 marks). Total = 100 marks.
- Passing Standard: A student must secure a minimum of 40% marks in the SEE and a minimum of 40% aggregate marks (CIE + SEE) to earn course credits.
- SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) = Σ(Credits × Grade Points) / Σ(Credits) for the semester.
- CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) = Σ(Credits × Grade Points) across all completed semesters / Total Credits registered.
- Minimum CGPA for Degree: A minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average of 5.0 is required for the award of undergraduate and postgraduate degrees.

title: SSM Sigma Coins: Allocation Rules for Extracurriculars, Sports, Leadership, and Startups
content:
Sigma Coins are awarded for non-academic, extracurricular excellence, leadership, sports, and entrepreneurship:
1. Leadership & Student Bodies:
  • Student Council President: 1500 coins (Cap/Degree: 1500, Dean SW)
  • Student Council Members: 750 coins (Cap/Degree: 750, Dean SW)
  • Approved Club President / Vice President / General Secretary: 500 coins (Cap/Degree: 400, Mentor)
  • Approved Organizing / Committee Team Member: 50 coins (Cap/Yr: 60, Degree: 200, Mentor)
2. Sports & Athletic Tournaments:
  • Sports within SRU: Participation = 25 coins; Winners = 1st: 100, 2nd: 75, 3rd: 50 coins (Sports Director)
  • State Level Sports: Participation = 100 coins; Winners = 1st: 400, 2nd: 300, 3rd: 200 coins (Cap/Yr: 400, Degree: 1000)
  • National Level Sports: Participation = 200 coins; Winners = 1st: 1000, 2nd: 750, 3rd: 500 coins (Cap/Yr: 1000, Degree: 2000)
  • International Level Sports: Participation = 1000 coins; Winners = 1st: 5000, 2nd: 3000, 3rd: 2000 coins (Cap/Yr: 5000, Degree: 10,000)
3. Startups, Innovation & Sponsorships:
  • Startup Launch: 300 coins (Cap/Degree: 600, Dean Startups)
  • Startup Funding (Min ₹1 Lakh): 100 × (Number of Lakhs raised; Cap/Degree: 1000, Dean Startups)
  • Getting Sponsors for University Events: 100 × (Number of Lakhs brought in; Cap/Degree: 1000, Dean SW)
4. Community Service, Defence & Volunteering:
  • NCC Cadets: 100 coins (Cap/Degree: 400, NCC In-charge)
  • Republic Day / Independence Day Parade Participation: 200 coins (Cap/Degree: 2000, NCC In-charge)
  • NSS Volunteers: 100 coins (Cap/Degree: 400, NSS In-charge)
  • Approved Event Participation with Certificate: 4 coins/hour (Cap/Yr: 40, Degree: 160, Mentor)
  • Approved Volunteer-ship: 4 coins/hour (Cap/Yr: 20, Degree: 80, Mentor)
  • Active Participation in Mentor Meetings: 5 coins (Cap/Yr: 20, Degree: 80, Mentor)
  • School (Work and Earn) Feedback: Feedback points × 10 (Head / Dean)
  • Social Media Achievement Posts about School (min 100 likes): 20 coins (Cap/Yr: 200, Degree: 1000, Mentor)
- Official Portal: https://sruniv.com/public/student/ssm/sigma-coins

title: SSM Penalty Coins: Discipline Deductions, Academic Misconduct, and Penalties
content:
Penalty Coins represent deductions subtracted from a student balance for academic malpractice, disciplinary breaches, or behavioral misconduct:
1. Cheating & Plagiarism (Authority: Controller of Examinations):
  • Cheating / Plagiarism (First Case): -500 coins
  • Cheating / Plagiarism (Repeated Cases): -1000 coins
2. Academic Failure:
  • Grade F (Fail in a course): -5 × Course Credits (Processed automatically via SRAAP)
3. Campus In-Discipline (Authority: Associate Dean of Student Welfare - Assoc. Dean SW):
  • In-Discipline (Severity Low): -200 coins
  • In-Discipline (Severity Low - Repeated Cases): -300 coins
  • In-Discipline (Severity Medium): -300 coins
  • In-Discipline (Severity Medium - Repeated Cases): -500 coins
  • In-Discipline (Severity High): -1000 coins
  • In-Discipline (Severity High - Repeated Cases): -5000 coins
4. Behavioral Misconduct & Backing Off (Authority: Department Head / Dean):
  • Misbehavior with Faculty or Staff: -1000 coins
  • Misbehavior with Faculty or Staff (Repeated Cases): -3000 coins
  • Backing Off in Volunteer-ship / In-Discipline: -500 coins
- Disciplinary Impact: Penalties directly reduce coin balances, impacting leaderboard ranking and badge eligibility.
- Official Portal: https://sruniv.com/public/student/ssm/penalty-coins

title: SSM Coin Redemption: University Perks, Privileges, Deadlines, and Fee Refunds
content:
Students can redeem accumulated Alpha & Sigma coins for exclusive privileges, academic accommodations, executive meetings, and tangible rewards:
1. Executive & Leadership Access:
  • Coffee with Vice Chancellor (VC): 1,000 coins
  • Photograph with Vice Chancellor (VC): 1,000 coins
  • Coffee with Dean: 500 coins
  • Meeting with Industry / International Delegates: 1,000 coins
  • Official SRU Social Media Post celebrating Student Achievement: 1,000 coins
  • Formal Positive Email or Call to Parents from University: 1,000 coins
2. Academic & Administrative Privileges:
  • Assignment / Project Submission Deadline Extension (Max 5 days): 1,000 coins per day
  • Extra Attempt for Missed Quiz or Assignment (One-time attempt): 1,000 coins
  • Lab / Equipment Access for 1 Day (Subject to equipment availability): 1,000 coins
  • Teaching Assistant (TA) Recommendation (If approved): 1,000 coins
  • Batch Change Recommendation (If approved): 1,000 coins
  • Change of Project / Research Mentorship Guidance (If approved): 1,000 coins
  • +1 Extra Vote for Batch Representative Election: 1,000 coins
  • University Committee Member Recommendation: 1,000 coins
  • Formal Approval to Attend Workshop Outside SRU: 500 coins
3. Merchandise & Financial Reimbursement:
  • SRU Official Goodies (Merchandise Pack): 2,000 coins
  • Workshop Fees Refund (Up to ₹1,000 INR): Calculated as Amount / 0.10 coins (e.g. ₹500 fee refund = 5,000 coins; ₹1,000 max refund = 10,000 coins)
- How to Redeem: Apply via the official redemption portal at https://sruniv.com/public/student/ssm/redeem or through the Student Success Management dashboard.
- Leaderboard: View overall competitive rankings at https://sruniv.com/public/student/ssm/leaderboard
